contract.purpose: Turn the completed PostTrainLLM research corpus into a trustworthy learning artifact and practical lab.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md and the owner-approved closure direction in GitHub issue #136
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM takes learners from ML and transformer foundations to Mac-local models, adapters, evals, agents, packages, runtimes, and interpretability by making every stage produce an inspectable artifact.
contract.audience: Learners and practitioners building, modifying, tuning, evaluating, and packaging AI systems on Apple Silicon and in the browser.
contract.job: Guide a learner from first principles to a real model, adapter, benchmark, agent, package, runtime decision, or causal probe while keeping historical evidence and fresh experiments distinct.
contract.thesis: Preserve the existing dark local-research-bench system and make evidence lineage the visual hierarchy.
contract.system: Existing ink surfaces, teal verified-state accents, coral cautions, Bricolage headings, Geist prose, Geist Mono evidence labels, responsive evidence cards, and explicit status text.
contract.signature: A nine-stage artifact ladder where every outcome exposes build, modify, tune, prove, and package actions, with evidence and the runnable CLI one click away.
contract.risk: The archive is information-dense; search, status filters, concise cards, separate learning paths, and persistent mobile navigation must keep it navigable without hiding limitations.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser run build && pnpm --dir browser run visual:audit
projectCheck.note: The production build generated 46 Astro pages, 310 docs pages, and 358 paired agent surfaces; the rendered audit passed seven key routes at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels with zero failures.

interactionChecks: Primary navigation remains keyboard-visible and horizontally scrollable at narrow viewports
artifact journey renders 9 stages and 13 buildable outcomes with readiness and workload labels
browserReview.note: Fresh preserve-lane renders confirm readable hierarchy, usable controls, deliberate narrow-screen navigation, and no P0/P1 defects. The audit found zero horizontal overflow, console errors, page errors, or failed requests across 21 route/viewport combinations; it also verified 75 attempts, 2 Needle search results, 38 caveated results, 18 recipes, 9 learning paths, 9 journey stages, and 13 buildable artifacts.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner approved the project-completion spec and explicitly asked for a strong learning artifact and lab; the implementation preserves the existing design system.
